name: ILI Cato Limited
ownership_summary: Wholly-owned project SPV; PSC is Intelligent Land Investments Group Plc (SC564296) with 75%+ shares and voting rights and the right to appoint/remove directors. Sole director Mark Thomas Wilson (appointed at incorporation, 7 Oct 2024). Registered office 33 Bothwell Road, Hamilton ML3 0AS. SIC 41201 (construction of commercial buildings).
notes: Identified as the applicant company by press and Fife Council statements; the portal's named applicant is 'Mr Greig Templeton'.

name: Intelligent Land Investments Group Plc (ILI Group)
ownership_summary: Parent and person with significant control of ILI Cato Limited; Hamilton-based land/energy developer (BESS, pumped hydro, and the 'Stoics' data centre portfolio). CEO Mark Wilson.
notes: Also parent of the wider ~1.5 GW Stoics network: Cato (Fife, 600 MW), Rufus (East Ayrshire, 540 MW), Aurelius (North Lanarkshire, 400 MW); network investment claimed at £15bn.

name: Intelligent Land Investments Group Plc (ILI Group)
Graeme Nicholls Architects
notes: Glasgow practice; architect for Cato and the other two Stoics projects; design references Ancient Greek stoa architecture.

name: LoganPM (agent: Simon Munro)
notes: Planning agent on 26/01243/PPP, address Inverlair Farm, Tulloch, Roy Bridge PH31 4AR.

name: BiGGAR Economics
notes: Author of the economic impact assessment cited by the developer (job-years and GVA figures).

name: Fife Council
notes: Case officer Scott Simpson; ward Burntisland, Kinghorn and West Kirkcaldy. Issued the contested 'EIA not required' screening opinion (1 Apr 2026).

name: Auchtertool Community Council
notes: Initially a neutral facilitator gathering resident views (Nov 2025); formally objected to 26/01243/PPP, describing it as 'ill-conceived and inappropriate'. Chair Andrea Cail.

name: Say No to Cato
notes: Local campaign group opposing the development (Facebook-based), promoted by APRS.

name: Action to Protect Rural Scotland (APRS)
notes: National campaign group; published an EIA scoping analysis and a formal objection (author Nikki Sinclair, Policy Manager); calculates full-build energy use at ~4,200 GWh/yr.

name: SEPA
notes: Statutory consultee; lodged a holding objection in July 2026 requesting further flooding information.

name: Scottish Water Horizons
notes: Involved in pre-application discussions on water supply; existing mains reported too small, a new pipe likely required.
